name: t1_shadow_candidate
rule: frozen/t1_lighter_pm_arb.json, unchanged (trigger > 4c after both fees; Lighter leg at trigger price or better, matched 500 ms after; PM hedge 500 ms after that at the prevailing price; 5 s cooldown; clip min(displayed) <= 200)
assets_note: ETH passed the holdout, but 2 of 11 days carry it (median day +$8); shadow BTC as the decision asset and ETH as descriptive only

shadow.mode: paper on live feeds: Lighter from Tokyo (book + trades), Polymarket book from Dublin (exchange time), no orders
shadow.log: per trigger: trigger time, both books at trigger, +100/+300/+500 ms, PM book at hedge time and +100 ms, real Lighter taker prints within 1 s, settlement on both venues

pass_all: BTC $/day 90% interval (resampling windows) above 0 with pessimistic fills (Lighter quote and PM hedge each still showing >= 5 shares at the price 100 ms after their match)
BTC c/share >= +2.0 at 500+500 in that pessimistic count (leaves room for the 1.4c live-taker slippage seen on Polymarket)
share of triggers whose Lighter quote is still displayed 300 ms later >= 0.80
kill_any: rolling 7-day BTC c/share < 0 in the pessimistic count
Lighter quote still displayed +300 ms < 0.65 of triggers (someone faster is taking it)
any Lighter vs Polymarket settlement disagreement
fee or resolution-source change on either venue (re-freeze needed)

min_size_probe_after_shadow_pass.size: 5 shares per leg (min order), BTC only
min_size_probe_after_shadow_pass.limits: max 20 pairs/day, max $25 open cost, Lighter IOC at the trigger price, PM FAK hedge with limit = prevailing ask + 1c, no hedge chase beyond that (log unhedged)
min_size_probe_after_shadow_pass.measure: real Lighter fill rate vs model, real hedge slippage vs model, unhedged share, c/share net
min_size_probe_after_shadow_pass.stop: unhedged legs > 10% of pairs, or c/share < 0 after 50 pairs
min_size_probe_after_shadow_pass.note: needs operator approval and a separate deploy; nothing was sent tonight
